XenotypeDef.label: nanite precursor
XenotypeDef.description: A synthetic precursor humanoid maintained by coordinated nanomachines. It eats ordinary food as feedstock, stores converted material in a visible reserve, reconstructs damage, carries a neural interface and collective link, and is vulnerable to EMP disruption.

XenotypeDef.label: human-form replicator
XenotypeDef.description: A human-shaped Replicator assembled from coordinated nanomachines. It remains a Human pawn for social and pawn-generation systems while its nanite package provides feedstock reserve, reconstruction, neural-interface compatibility, collective identity and EMP vulnerability.
